text: …おぼえて　いきませんか？

structure.jp: …おぼえて　いきませんか？
structure.en: ...won't you learn it before you go?

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.span: おぼえて　いきませんか
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb says you do it and then go on your way. おぼえて　いきませんか = 'won't you learn it before you go?'.

patterns.name: 〜ませんか
patterns.explanation: ませんか on a verb is a polite invitation, like 'won't you...?'. いきませんか = 'won't you go and do it?'.
